en.topic_title: HKFP Lens: Hong Kong LGBTQ+ groups stage ‘Rainbow Strength’ fitness contest after Pride market venue axed
en.topic_summary:
LGBTQ+ groups in Hong Kong have staged an inclusive fitness event dubbed “Rainbow Strength,” after their annual Pride market faced venue cancellations for a second consecutive year – renewing concerns over dwindling civic space in the city.



The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
